accordionMode.description: Whether one or many sections can be open

tint.description: Line color (unset = the text color at 20%)

controls.description: Control Center / lock-screen / Action-button controls (toggle, button, cycle, step, set)

slots.description: Up to 3 control ids for secondary readouts

lines.description: Most lines the text may take (1 = truncate, N = wrap up to N, 0 = wrap freely). Also limits the subtitle

placeholder.description: Shown by a relative-date label with no date yet (default "Never")

scrollable.description: Fixed-height scrolling terminal/log view that keeps the latest line in view (pair with controlHeight)

style.description: Text style variant (terminal = ANSI terminal renderer)

subtitle.description: A quieter second line under the text (caption size, secondary color). In a list itemTemplate it takes {{item.<field>}}

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. celsius, km/h). A numeric value converts to the device locale; text values show as sent. Unknown strings show literally.

valueMap.description: Incoming value → display text ("default" catches the rest)

accentColor.description: Hex accent for the layout's library card, switcher and glance fallback (e.g. "#5AC8FA"); controls use theme.accentColor (see theming#Cascade)

alerts.description: Alert rules the app evaluates on incoming events (id, event, valuePath, ...)

appearance.description: App shell appearance (color scheme, header, background image)

batchPublishers.description: Send the publishers as one sensor_batch frame per tick of the fastest interval instead of one frame per reading (see publishers)

derive.description: Values computed on the phone from other values, keyed by id, e.g. {'watts': {'mul': [{'control': 'volts'}, {'control': 'amps'}]}} (see derive)

extensions.description: Reverse-DNS keyed tool data the app preserves and never interprets (64 KB cap; see document-contract)

glance.description: Widgets, Dynamic Island, lock screen and Control Center surfaces projected from this layout (see glance)

headerTitle.description: Title shown in the header bar

hubSurfaces.description: What the layout's hub may draw in the app: false for nothing, or an object of the [[hub-surfaces]] keys (progress, toast, haptic, island, log), each default on; absent = all on. The person's own off wins (see docs/HUB-SURFACES.md)

id.description: Stable layout identifier (see Identity); default scope for a local store namespace

keepAwake.description: Ask to suppress the iOS auto screen lock while this layout is open (a request the user can veto)

liveness.description: Layout-wide staleness default for sync bindings, e.g. {'staleAfter': 120} (opt-in; HTTP polls use max(this, 3x interval); see sync)

mode.description: pair connects to one peer; room joins a shared room

publishers.description: Sensor publishers: device sensors streamed out as readings (see publishers)

requires.description: The app version and features this layout needs, e.g. {'app': '1.3', 'features': ['control.symbol']}; a soft gate, so an older app still renders what it can and shows one update banner (see Requires and fallback)

sampleValues.description: Control id to placeholder value: display only. Shown by Try and previews, and on the live page by a control with no value of its own until its first real one; never sent, saved or published. Applies without a tap unless a sample holds a link (see Sample values)

schemaVersion.description: Grammar version, optional (absent = 1); set by writers, bumped only when an older app would misread the file

secrets.description: Credentials the layout's {{secret:name}} placeholders use: name, label, kind, hosts, mesh, allowInsecureHTTP. Names only; the values live in the phone's Keychain (see Secrets)

sensorSetup.description: Which device sensors and permissions the layout asks the user to set up (see sensors)

sources.description: Named external data sources (MQTT brokers, HTTP APIs)

state.description: State sync config: lets the layout's own control values sync through a mesh

theme.description: Visual theme (colors, fonts, spacing, palette tokens)

token.description: Auth token; prefer a {{secret:name}} placeholder, never a literal secret

url.description: WebSocket URL of the mesh server

version.description: The author's revision label (required; never gates anything — see document-contract)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

defaultValue.description: Seed rows shown before the first sync (the same row objects a sync delivers)

emptyText.description: Line shown when the list has no rows. Default: \"No <label> yet\".

formatValue.description: Default date format for columns with no `format` of their own: relative:day (4 days ago), relative, date, date:time. Applies to date text and epoch numbers; other text shows as is.

itemLayout.description: rows: one templated row per line. grid: the itemTemplate rows as cards side by side, as many columns as keep each card 150 pt wide or more, at most 3 (2 on a phone-wide list, 3 on an iPad or in landscape, 1 on a list too narrow for two), itemSpacing apart; paging, search, row taps and itemStyle work as in rows. Needs an itemTemplate: column rows stay one per line. Any other value is rows. See [[#Card grid]].

itemSpacing.description: Points between rows (0-64, default 2), and between the cards of a card grid (itemLayout: grid).

itemStyle.description: plain: rows sit inside the list's card. card: each itemTemplate row draws its template group's own card (fill, corners, theme), so rows read as separate cards; pair it with hideBackground: true and an itemSpacing. See [[#Card rows]].

itemTemplate.description: A group definition ({grid, children}) drawn once per row; {{item.<field>}} in its children's text, values, images and payloads is replaced from that row. Absent: rows are columns. See [[#Item templates]].

listColumns.description: Column definitions: [{key, label, format}]. Absent or empty: a store-bound list shows its collection's first fields, any other list its rows' own keys.

pageSize.description: Rows asked for per request, sent as {{limit}} (5-200). A hub may send fewer.

paging.description: Rows fed by the hub a page at a time: {pageSize, request, replyType, replyPath, window, queryFrom}. Absent: the list shows the rows its sync delivers. See [[#Paging]].

queryFrom.description: Id of a text input whose text is the search, sent as {{query}}. A change starts the list over after 250 ms without typing.

replyPath.description: Dot path from the reply frame to the page object, e.g. result for {msg_type, req, result: {rows, total}}. Absent: the frame is the page.

replyType.description: msg_type of the hub's page broadcasts. A page is {items (or rows), cursor?, total?, more?, offset?, query?, req?}; a frame of this type without items or rows is ignored.

request.description: The action sent for each page (meshsocket; `method` may be left out), with {{cursor}}, {{offset}}, {{limit}}, {{query}} and {{req}} filled into its payload. See [[#Paging]].

window.description: Most rows kept on the phone at once (at least 4 pages, at most 5000). Rows far from the screen are let go and asked for again when you scroll back.

collections.description: Collection name → { fields, shared?, mirror?, singleton?, defaults?, order? }; fields maps a name to one of string number integer bool date json, or to { type, label?, unit?, required?, default?, choices?, multiple?, range?, decimals?, labels?, symbol?, display? }

defaults.description: Starting values for the singleton row (needs singleton: true)

fields.description: Field name to type (string number integer bool date json) or {type, ...options}

from.description: The collection or view this view reads

label.description: Friendly collection name shown in the type builder

mirror.description: Reserved for the studio change-notice; stored, not read by the store

namespace.description: Scope for every non-shared collection (default the layout id, else its name); must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$ and cannot be "shared

shared.description: Put the collection in the device-wide shared namespace

singleton.description: The collection holds exactly one row, id singleton

type.description: Must be "local" — declared inside the layout's sources block

views.description: View name → { from, where?, orderBy?, limit? }; a named row set over a collection or another view

weekStartsOn.description: First day of the week for the week bucket and the startOfWeek token

controlHeight.description: Console area height in points (default: compact, capped at 200). Set it when the console should fill a tall grid span.

defaultValue.description: Seed lines shown before the first sync (strings, or objects with text and level)

tint.description: Color of the lines with no level

longPressAction.description: Action fired on long press (no popup)

center.description: Fixed camera centre [lat, lng] instead of fitting the data; combines with recenter (mapConfig.center)

controlHeight.description: Map height in points in a flow-mode grid (2-D grids size it by rowSpan)

coordinateOrder.description: Order of raw [a, b, weight] number triples, GeoJSON-style lnglat or latlng (mapConfig.coordinateOrder)

hideLabel.description: Hide the header label above the map

mapConfig.description: Property→style mapping for GeoJSON feeds (marker size/color/label/ripple)

mapStyle.description: Map rendering style (globe frames the whole Earth)

markerColorProperty.description: Feed property holding a hex color for each pin (mapConfig.markerColorProperty)

markerIdProperty.description: Property giving each pin a stable identity across updates; needed for smooth motion (mapConfig.markerIdProperty)

markerLabelProperty.description: Feed property used as each pin's label (mapConfig.markerLabelProperty)

markerLatProperty.description: Property holding latitude on each point object, e.g. "lat"; switches to object-array mode (mapConfig.markerLatProperty)

markerLngProperty.description: Property holding longitude on each point object, e.g. "lon" (mapConfig.markerLngProperty)

markerSizeProperty.description: Numeric feed property that drives pin size (mapConfig.markerSizeProperty), scaled from markerSizeDomain into markerSizeRange

markerSizeRange.description: Output pin diameter range [smallest, largest] in points (mapConfig.markerSizeRange)

markerSymbol.description: Default SF Symbol name for the symbol and puck pin styles, e.g. "airplane" (mapConfig.markerSymbol)

markerSymbolProperty.description: Per-object property naming an SF Symbol, overriding markerSymbol (mapConfig.markerSymbolProperty)

markersPath.description: Dot-path to the array of point objects in a non-GeoJSON payload, e.g. "ac" (mapConfig.markersPath)

maxMarkers.description: Cap on drawn pins; a public feed can be unbounded (mapConfig.maxMarkers)

minWeight.description: In number-triple mode, drop points whose weight is below this before capping (mapConfig.minWeight)

motion.description: Glide pins between updates instead of snapping; needs markerIdProperty with more than one pin (mapConfig.motion)

motionDuration.description: Seconds one position glide takes; set near the poll interval (mapConfig.motionDuration)

recenter.description: How the camera reacts to new data (mapConfig.recenter)

ripple.description: Ring styling for rippling pins: color, period (s, default 1.6), radius (pt, default 44) (mapConfig.ripple)

rippleProperty.description: Numeric feed property that decides which pins ripple (mapConfig.rippleProperty)

rippleThreshold.description: rippleProperty >= rippleThreshold makes that pin ripple (mapConfig.rippleThreshold)

tint.description: Default marker color (used when a marker carries none)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

optionIcons.description: Optional SF Symbols parallel to options, supported in every picker style

optionLabels.description: Display labels parallel to options; actions and sync use the original option values

placeholder.description: Text shown when no options are available or a picker has no selection

centerText.description: Donut center text; {{total}} interpolates the slice sum

explodeSelected.description: Tapped slice pops outward (**wheels default false)

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the slices in their own colours, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

icon.description: SF Symbol in the wheel/menu hub before a result lands

percent.description: Show values as % of the total

pieStyle.description: Classic pie, donut, spin-to-select wheel, or radial menu

showLabels.description: Slice labels (auto-hidden on thin slices; *menu defaults false — icons lead)

showLegend.description: Wrapping dot-chip legend under the chart

showValues.description: Append each slice's value to its label

sliceCornerRadius.description: Rounds every slice corner (outer and donut inner) in points, clamped for tiny slices

sliceGap.description: Even-width gap between neighbouring slices in points (slices narrower than the gap drop it)

spinDuration.description: Approximate seconds a full-strength spin takes to settle

spinTicks.description: Haptic tick per slice boundary while spinning

startAngle.description: Degrees the first slice starts at (0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise)

surfacePrimary.description: Background fill (also the hairline slice gap color)

background.description: SF Symbol drawn faint behind the surface (floor-plan / map backdrop)

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids)

hidePalette.description: Hide the option area (surfaces whose markers all start placed)

searchable.description: Show a filter field above the option area

arcThickness.description: Ring stroke width, or bar height, in points. Absent scales with the control size.

barCornerRadius.description: Corner rounding of the linear bar (progressStyle bar)

colorByValue.description: Color zones [{limit, color}] in the min–max unit — the fill takes the zone colour of the current value (gauge semantics). Overrides tint.

forecast.description: Look ahead beside the real reading: countdown = the value is a time and the widget counts down to it; reach = the value is expected to arrive at forecastTarget (at the time forecastTimeFrom holds) or to keep moving by forecastRate per second. A newer real value always replaces the guess; past its end the value reads stale.

forecastRate.description: Keep moving by this much per second from the last real reading (forecast "reach", no time needed)

forecastTarget.description: The value this one is expected to arrive at (with forecast "reach")

forecastTimeFrom.description: Id of the control whose value is the arrival time (epoch seconds or ISO-8601), for forecast "reach

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the ring or bar fill in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

hideValue.description: Show just the arc — hide the center value

lineCap.description: End shape of the ring (the linear bar rounds its corners for round, squares them for butt and square). Cross-control, same on every control

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. celsius, km/h). With a unit the readout shows the value itself (converted to the device locale) instead of the fill percentage; min and max stay in this unit. Unknown strings show literally.

interval.description: Seconds between frames (defaults per sensor; clamped to a safe floor)

sensor.description: Pipeline to stream (heading, motion, barometer, device, audio, location)

direction.description: Ring expands outward or contracts inward

event.description: Server event that fires the pulse

spread.description: Ring travel as a fraction of the group's size (0.1 = 10%)

hideLabel.description: Hide the caption below the code

qrBackground.description: Fill behind the code (default: none, the card shows through)

text.description: Static content to encode (overridden by sync)

curved.description: Rounded polygon instead of straight edges

editable.description: Drag the **first** series' vertices along their axes

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind each series outline in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of each series outline: it is a closed shape, so the cap sets its corners (round = round, square = sharp, butt = cut). Cross-control, same on every control

showValues.description: Numeric value beside each vertex (the dragged vertex always shows)

step.description: Snap dragged values to this step (e.g. 1, 5, 0.1)

cellCornerRadius.description: Node corner rounding (default: a third of the node width)

nodeSpacing.description: Minimum vertical gap between nodes in a column

scrub.description: Drag sweeps the spotlight from node to node with haptic ticks (the action still fires on tap)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

optionLabels.description: Display labels parallel to options; actions and sync use the original option values

placeholder.description: Text shown when no options are available or a picker has no selection

style.description: System segmented, capsule pills, or tap-a-star rating (options "1"…"N"; sends the number)

method.description: Set to "sensor" on a sync entry to bind local hardware

arcAngle.description: Arc sweep in degrees (radial style only)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

continuous.description: Send actions while dragging; false previews locally and sends once on release

hideValue.description: Hide numeric readouts in every slider style; keep the label and interaction

step.description: Detent spacing measured from min; zero or negative allows continuous values

columns.description: How many zone columns to lay out

controlHeight.description: Rendered height in points (required in flow-mode grids — see Sizing)

hidePalette.description: Hide the option area (server-seeded boards where items start placed)

searchable.description: Show a filter field above the option area

baseURL.description: HTTP base URL relative sync/action paths resolve against

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every poll/request; put credentials in as {{secret:name}}

interval.description: Default poll interval (seconds) for HTTP syncs that omit their own

password.description: MQTT password; write a {{secret:name}} placeholder, not the literal value

type.description: Kind of source (mqtt or http external, local on-device store)

url.description: MQTT broker address: mqtt://host[:port] or mqtts://host[:port]

colorBlend.description: How much the zone colors blend, 0–1. 0 = hard boundaries, 1 = one smooth gradient. Needs colorByValue.

colorByValue.description: Color zones [{limit, color}] — the line and fill take the zone colour of the value at each height. Overrides tint.

defaultValue.description: Seed series drawn before the first sync (an array of numbers), trimmed to sparklinePoints

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the line in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

lineCap.description: End shape of the line. Cross-control, same on every control

lineWidth.description: Line stroke width in points. Omit to scale with the control's height.

sparklineFill.description: Fill the area under the line with a gradient

sparklinePoints.description: Max data points retained in the buffer

animation.description: Motion profile for the number roll

criticalAbove.description: At or above this value the tile fills solid with its band colour

criticalBelow.description: At or below this value the tile fills solid with its band colour

deltaMode.description: Percent change, or the absolute difference in the value's unit

formatValue.description: Number format for the big number (see the formatValue table, e.g. decimal:1)

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the history curve in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

hideBackground.description: Remove the card (and its threshold tint)

invertDelta.description: Colour a rise red and a fall green (latency, error rate)

lineCap.description: End shape of the history curve. Cross-control, same on every control

lineWidth.description: Stroke width of the faint trend line, in points

reference.description: The value the change is measured against (yesterday, target…)

referencePath.description: Dot path in the same payload as the value to a live reference; overrides reference once it arrives

showSparkline.description: Draw the faint history sparkline under the number

sparklinePoints.description: Max values kept in the faint history sparkline

step.description: Determines decimal formatting of the number when formatValue is unset

thresholds.description: Background bands [{limit, color}], gauge segment semantics

tint.description: Sparkline colour when no thresholds are set

unit.description: Measurement unit the value arrives in ([[values#Units]] name or symbol, e.g. milliseconds, celsius). Shown small beside the number and converted to the device locale; thresholds, reference and delta stay in this unit. Unknown strings show literally.

valueSize.description: Point size of the big number

glow.description: Halo strength behind the light, 0 (none) to 1 (full). The badge style tints its pill by the same amount.

statusColors.description: Map state strings to hex colors: {\"online\": \"#34C759\", \"offline\": \"#FF3B30\"}

style.description: dot (circle) or badge (pill with state text)

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

formatValue.description: Value format: decimal, percent, time, duration, bytes, bytesKB, bps, relative or none; decimal:N, prefix:X and suffix:X also work in JSON

hideValue.description: Hide the numeric readout; keep the buttons, label, and spoken value

repeatOnHold.description: Hold plus or minus to repeat steps using the system repeat behavior

step.description: Positive increment/decrement amount; zero or negative falls back to 1

wraps.description: Step past an endpoint to cycle to the opposite endpoint

activeWhen.description: always | truthy | a state word the synced value must equal

effect.description: Native symbol effect or custom rain, snow, sparkle animation

effectOptions.description: Effect modifiers in Apple's words: iterative, cumulative, reversing, hideInactiveLayers, up, down, clockwise, byLayer, wholeSymbol …

glowRadius.description: Soft glow behind the glyph in its own colour, in points (0 = none). Cross-control, same on every control

iconMap.description: Incoming value → SF Symbol name ("default" catches the rest)

loopCount.description: periodic only — plays before stopping (omit for forever)

palette.description: Hex colour per layer (primary, secondary, tertiary) for palette rendering

particleAngle.description: Rain/snow direction in degrees from vertical (negative left, positive right)

particleColor.description: Custom particle colour (default tint; blue rain, white snow, yellow sparkles in multicolor)

particleIntensity.description: Rain, snow, sparkle density (0 hides particles)

renderingMode.description: SF rendering mode — multicolor uses the symbol's own colours

size.description: Explicit point size (default scales to the cell)

symbolConfig.description: Full configuration object holding every field marked group symbolConfig

systemName.description: SF Symbol name (the glyph at rest)

transition.description: How a glyph change animates (default replace; none when the value is numeric)

triggers.description: Server events that play a one-shot effect: [{ event, filter?, effect, effectOptions? }]

variableMax.description: Numeric value at which the variable layers are full

variableMin.description: Numeric value at which the variable layers are empty

variant.description: Symbol variant applied on top of the name

aggregate.description: Collapse rows to one value — "count" or {op, field} with sum/avg/min/max/distinct/first/last (local)

collection.description: Collection or view name in the local source (local, required)

endsAtPath.description: Dot path to an end time (epoch seconds or ISO-8601, e.g. an ETA) beside the value; widgets, Lock Screen and Live Activity count down / fill toward it with no push, and the next real value replaces it

event.description: MeshSocket frame type to match (meshsocket). Server broadcasts arrive as "broadcast" (demux with filter.msg_type); any other name only matches frames routed to this device by route_msg_noreply

filter.description: Key-value pairs to match incoming messages

from.description: The id of a layout derive entry this control shows (derive)

group.description: Event group the binding belongs to (meshsocket, optional)

groupBy.description: Bucket rows — a field name, {field, bucket} for dates or {field, width} for numbers (local)

having.description: Filter on aggregated groups: {key|value: {op: v}} (local, with groupBy)

method.description: Transport method (meshsocket, mqtt, http, sensor, local, derive)

sensor.description: On-device stream to bind when method is sensor, e.g. heading (see [[sensors]])

source.description: Named entry in the layout's sources (mqtt/http/local)

staleAfter.description: Seconds after the last source arrival before the value counts as stale (opt-in, except HTTP polls default to max(layout liveness.staleAfter, 3x interval); 0 opts out; overrides the layout's liveness.staleAfter)

timestampPath.description: Dot path to epoch seconds or ISO-8601 in the frame; age runs from that timestamp instead of receipt time

topic.description: MQTT topic filter to subscribe (mqtt; supports +/#)

where.description: Row filter — field → operator object, or and/or combinators (local)

autocorrectToggle.description: Inline Aa button that flips autocorrect on the live keyboard

clearOnSubmit.description: Clear the field after the return-key submit

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

icon.description: SF Symbol shown in the field

maxLines.description: Composer max lines before it scrolls internally

sendButton.description: Growing composer with a Send button (Return inserts a newline)

accent.description: Theme token. Accent colour; overrides the pack, loses to a control's own look

corners.description: Theme token. Corner shape (4, 12 or 22 pt)

dark.description: Overrides applied last when the app is in dark mode; keys are the schemeOverride group fields

fontFamily.description: Custom font family name (e.g. Times New Roman)

knobShadow.description: Draw a shadow under the knob

light.description: Overrides applied last when the app is in light mode; keys are the schemeOverride group fields

neutral.description: Neutral role colour, or a {light, dark} pair

onAccent.description: Text/icon colour drawn on an accent fill (scheme override)

palette.description: Named colours written once, referenced as $name in any colour field

primary.description: Primary role colour, or a {light, dark} pair

progressBar.description: Per-type progressBar sub-theme; keys are the progressBar group fields

scrimColor.description: Dimming scrim behind sheets and popups (scheme override)

secondary.description: Secondary role colour, or a {light, dark} pair

segmented.description: Per-type segmented sub-theme; keys are the segmented group fields

selectedShadow.description: Draw a shadow under the selected segment

slider.description: Per-type slider sub-theme; keys are the slider group fields

stepper.description: Per-type stepper sub-theme; keys are the stepper group fields

tertiary.description: Tertiary role colour, or a {light, dark} pair

thumbShadow.description: Draw a shadow under the thumb

toggle.description: Per-type toggle sub-theme; keys are the toggle group fields

confirm.description: After this control's local write lands, show a pill naming the change with an Undo button for 3 seconds (default off)

knobActiveColor.description: Knob fill color while on; the knob blends to it as it travels (defaults to knobColor)

offIcon.description: SF Symbol when off (button and icon-toggle styles)

onIcon.description: SF Symbol when on (button and icon-toggle styles)

trackCurvature.description: Degrees of bend; 0 straight, positive bows up. Clamped to what the length can bend (lengthen the track to curve it more)

trackLength.description: Track extent tip-to-tip along its path (pt)

drillDown.description: Tap a parent to zoom into its children

scrub.description: Drag highlights the cell under the finger with a live readout (no drilling/actions until a tap)

showLabels.description: Item labels inside cells that have room

showValues.description: Value under the label (taller cells only)

unit.description: Measurement unit name or symbol for a measurement ([[values#Units]]); controls with a unit field convert to the device locale

valueType.description: The kind of value a capability produces

any.description: At least one listed condition must hold

not.description: The listed condition must NOT hold

operator.description: Comparison operator (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists; aliases neq, is, isNot). Omitted = eq

ref.description: Leaf subject — exactly one of {control: id}, {selected: collection}, {field: formId.cell} or {derive: form.formId.cell}

stale.description: With `when` — true shows only while that control's feed is stale (went quiet past its staleAfter); false only while it is not. No `operator` or `value`

value.description: Value to compare against (required on every leaf)

when.description: Legacy leaf — the control ID to watch (same as ref.control)
